title: The Pale Signal Anew
author: Petra Reyes
blurb: Beatrix Vane, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
